jobInfo.postDescription:
Responsibilities
1. In charge of technical support and handle urgent escalation from high profile institution customers for API trading related issues in a production environment with high-volume transactions.
2. Strong collaboration, communication and interaction with all stakeholders including customers, product manager, developer and management team.
3. Work closely with product and developer teams in global offices, participate and follow up in iteration, release and roadmap planning timely.
4. Very flexible with the capability to prioritize multiple incidents and deadlines to facilitate well in a fast-paced, rapidly evolving organization.
5. High responsibility for continuous improvement in service quality and efficiency.
6. Ability to provide coaching, training, identification, optimization and documentation of the customer or business support processes.
7. Ability to continuously extend support offering to users based on market situation Ability to handle senior management communication and escalation. 

Requirements 
1. Experience in software engineering, providing technical support or using Exchange APIs.
2. Programming experience is a good plus. 1+ years of experience in similar roles - e.g. Technical Support Engineer, SL3 Engineer, Application Owner, etc.
3. Experience in trading or developing trading programs over traditional financial instruments or crypto currencies is required.
4. Familiar with at least one programming language (such as Java, Python, C++, etc.), able to read and understand code, and help customers solve integration problems.
5. Understand common data exchange formats such as HTTP protocol, JSON, and have basic debugging skills.
6. Good command of English (both spoken and written). Bilingual in English and Mandarin is preferred. 
7. Good communication skills, able to clearly and concisely explain technical issues and provide solutions to customers.
8. Understanding of software development methodologies and coding standards.
9. Experience with software application debugging and troubleshooting.
10. Familiar with technical support processes and escalation management.
11. Passionate with technical support to solve complicated customer issues.
12. Ability to present or speak fluently to engineers, product managers, high profile customers and senior leadership team.
13. Background in Software Development is a plus.
